audit_name: Official Held-Out Test Entity Overlap & Split Provenance Investigation

protocol_classification_verdict.operational_definition: The official held-out test evaluates model generalizability to completely novel job specifications (71 unseen jobs, 0% job overlap) when applied to previously profiled candidate resumes (476 shared resumes, 99.79% overlap).

resolution_of_historical_contradiction.earlier_audit_claim: PHASE12E_RESEARCH_READINESS_AUDIT.md and Phase 12F reported 476 of 477 test resumes (99.79%) were seen in training.
resolution_of_historical_contradiction.phase12i9_report_text: Phase 12I.8 and Phase 12I.9 summary tables listed 'Entity Separation: 0 Overlap'.
resolution_of_historical_contradiction.reconciliation: The Phase 12E audit was factually correct: 476 of 477 candidate resumes appear in the training CSV. The Phase 12I.8/12I.9 table label '0 Overlap' was an imprecise shorthand intended to indicate '0 Job Overlap and 0 Pair Overlap' (as certified in manifest_v1.json). It caused readers to incorrectly infer zero candidate overlap. This register formally corrects the description: held_out_test_v1.parquet has 0% job overlap and 99.79% candidate overlap.
